observations.body: Jesus names Jerusalem, delivery, condemnation, Gentiles, mockery, scourging, crucifixion, and the third day in a compact forward sequence.
observations.label: Mocked, scourged, and crucified: textual observation

observations.body: Jesus takes the Twelve aside; chief priests, scribes, and Gentiles appear inside the predicted action.
observations.label: Mocked, scourged, and crucified: action, promise, or consequence

observations.body: The verbs move from handing over to public abuse and execution before the final time marker.
observations.label: Relationships named in Matthew 20:17–19

payload.posture: Read Matthew 20:17–19 as its own anticipation and stated approach crucifixion setting before carrying its language into another source.
payload.tension: The saying is detailed about actors and actions while recording no response from the Twelve in this range.
payload.title: Mocked, scourged, and crucified
